tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ Per-run unique scratch root and TCP port convention documented and enforced; install-leg ownership marker prevents cross-lane teardown; pre-spawn deconfliction probe fails loudly on live-state collision; two-lane dry run proves it.: All four sub-requirements verified with live command output. (1) DOCUMENTED: docs/dogfood/scratch-port-ownership-convention.md documents lane_scratch_allocate (mktemp -d randomized root, mode 0700, run.state mode 0600), lane_scratch_allocate_port (atomic noclobber lock-file claim over seq 20000-45000 plus ss listening probe), LANE_PORT_LOCK_DIR override, and explicitly forbids shared names like /tmp/df-<project>-<date> and fixed ports. (2) ENFORCED: ops/lane-scratch.sh implements the primitives and is wired into real entrypoints — git show 4f5e18cb replaces fixed PA=3600/PB=3601/PC=3602 and mktemp /tmp/dbg-dogfood-XXXXXX in ops/dogfood-e2e.sh with lane_scratch_allocate + three lane_scratch_allocate_port calls, and replaces CANARY_PORT=3603 in ops/dogfood-phase8-s3gate.sh; git show 58defeb0 makes allocation fatal (|| exit 1) and rechecks lane_scratch_assert_owner immediately before each daemon spawn in start_daemon. (3) OWNERSHIP MARKER: lane_scratch_claim_agent writes agents/<agent>/<pid>/ownership.tag; lane_scratch_teardown_agent (ops/lane-scratch.sh:70-93) refuses with 'agent teardown refused:' on run/agent mismatch and also refuses when a foreign tag exists at another agent path; dogfood-e2e.sh cleanup kills only after teardown validation succeeds. (4) LOUD PRE-SPAWN PROBE: lane_scratch_assert_owner (ops/lane-scratch.sh:19-31) returns 1 on missing run.state or mismatch, emitting 'scratch collision: path=... requested_run=... requested_agent=... existing_run=... existing_agent=...' to stderr. (5) TWO-LANE DRY RUN PROVEN LIVE: `bash ops/test-lane-scratch-deconfliction.sh /tmp/df2026-7-verify2.txt` -> SCRIPT_EXIT=0, output shows lane A root=...lane-A-M64F8qux port=20000, lane B root=...lane-B-8D69wHB0 port=20001 (distinct), forced collision probe emitted 'scratch collision: ... existing_run=...lane-A-M64F8qux existing_agent=lane-A-agent', and 'lane A evidence intact after lane B'; committed receipt .coding-hermes/evidence/DF-2026-7-two-lane-dry-run.txt matches. (6) TESTS FRESH: `npx vitest run src/ops/lane-scratch.test.ts` -> exit_code 0, 'Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 2 passed (2)'; src/ops/lane-scratch.test.ts asserts distinct roots+ports, collision stderr naming existing_run, and teardown refusal with tagged_agent=owner-a. Note: the working-tree diff showed only .gitreins/tasks.yaml and board metadata; the implementation landed in commits 4f5e18cb/58defeb0 merged at 52d474ba.
The collision-proof lane scratch/port convention is fully implemented in ops/lane-scratch.sh, documented, wired fail-closed into both dogfood entrypoints, covered by 2 passing vitest cases, and proven by a live two-lane dry run that exits 0 with distinct roots/ports and a loud named collision.
